input.quote: IBM may cancel any and all Purchase Orders against this Agreement at any time. In the event IBM cancels Purchase Order as the result of MSL's default, no cancellation charge shall be applicable. IBM's termination of Purchase Orders for its convenience shall not relieve IBM of any cost reimbursements under the Price section.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty or minimum-fee obligation payable by IBM as customer, which meets the preferred position. A full-text search for "liquidated" returns nothing, and the only "penalty" mechanic (§7.3 b), p0757 — responsiveness shortfall penalty applied to MSL's Work Center material cost and invoiced by IBM to MSL) runs in our favour, as do the delinquency-based Shipment Profit Rate adjustments and §10.4 (MSL bears premium costs of late shipment). Termination provisions impose no exit fee on IBM: §6.1 lets IBM cancel Purchase Orders at any time with no cancellation charge, and §§5.2–5.3 limit IBM to paying for completed/partially completed Product and Parts actually procured against IBM forecasts — cost reimbursement rather than a stipulated penalty. On inventory risk, §13.2 e) expressly states IBM "will have no liability for unused flexibility" and §13.3 b) leaves untransferred EOL inventory as MSL's sole responsibility. Nothing to redline.
